entities.name: Siani
entities.description: A djinn of Tarkir's original timeline, formerly a Jeskai monk who found enlightenment in battle.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: The Jeskai path, with which Siani is associated.

entities.name: Ancient dragons
entities.description: Dragons whose voices Siani claims to hear while fighting.

events.summary: Siani, a Jeskai monk, believes true enlightenment is found in the stillness of battle.
events.quote: Siani believed that true enlightenment could only be discovered in the stillness of battle.
